remarks: This beautifully upgraded single story Canyon Country pool home seamlessly blends inviting interiors with elevated outdoor living. A sparkling pool with diving board and Guardian pool safety fence anchors the spacious private backyard, where a grassy lawn, lush mature landscaping, and palm trees create a relaxing setting. The expansive covered California room, complete with custom paver stones, offers an ideal space for outdoor dining, weekend gatherings, and year-round entertaining. Inside, the remodeled kitchen features custom cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a farmhouse sink.
